description: Paste any Solana signature or Base tx hash and get a one-sentence English explanation (e.g. 'Wallet X swapped 0.5 SOL for 1,203,442 BONK on Jupiter'), the action type (swap, transfer, mint, failed...), net asset changes for the signer and fee. Chain auto-detected. ($0.005 USDC per call via x402 at https://coinlight-app.vercel.app/p/tx-explain)

payment.description: Optional x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to use a free trial call or get payment requirements.

tx.description: Solana signature (base58) or Base 0x tx hash.

name: tx_explain
title: Explain a transaction in plain English (Solana + Base)
